overall.assessment: Podcast pokazuje iznimnu usklađenost s pozivom Crkve na 'novu evangelizaciju', koristeći digitalne platforme za premošćivanje jaza između Evanđelja i suvremene kulture mladih. Ispravno prepoznaje važnost osobnog svjedočanstva i suradnje klerika i laika u stvaranju kulture susreta. Pristup odražava zdravu pastoralnu strategiju koja balansira cjelovitost vjere sa stvarnostima modernog života, oslanjajući se na pedagošku mudrost sv. Ivana Bosca.

overall.theological_context: Podcast je uokviren crkvenim mandatom za evangelizaciju u digitalnom dobu, kako je artikulirano u *Evangelii Nuntiandi* (Pavao VI.), koji poziva na korištenje modernih sredstava za dosezanje mnoštva uz očuvanje cjelovitosti poruke. Također odražava nauk Katekizma o dostojanstvu ljudske osobe (KKC 1934) i proročkom poslanju laika (KKC 905) u svakodnevnim okolnostima svijeta.

sections.subtitle: Dvadeseta Epizoda BP Podcasta: Mladi, Vjera i Crkva
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj Marino s gostima u studiju, slavi jubilarnu 20. epizodu podcasta.
sections.content: Voditelj Marino započeo je jubilarnu, dvadesetu epizodu BP podcasta izražavajući veliko zadovoljstvo i sreću cijele ekipe. Istaknuo je kako je tema večerašnje emisije iznimno važna i aktualna: mladi, njihov odnos prema vjeri i Crkvi, te izazovi s kojima se susreću. Marino je naglasio da je ova tema odabrana kako bi se dublje istražili razlozi udaljenosti mladih od vjere i kako im se može pomoći u pronalaženju puta prema duhovnosti. U uvodnom dijelu, Marino je zahvalio publici na podršci tijekom dosadašnjih devetnaest epizoda, ističući kako je vrijeme brzo prošlo i kako se raduje nastavku. Ova jubilarna epizoda obećava dubok i iskren razgovor o jednoj od najvažnijih tema u suvremenom društvu.

magisterium.assessment: Sadržaj je u potpunosti usklađen s katoličkim naukom o važnosti pastoralne skrbi za mlade i evangelizacije. Naglasak na dijalogu i razumijevanju izazova mladih odražava crkvenu praksu poticanja aktivnog sudjelovanja mladih u životu Crkve.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva prepoznaje mlade kao ključne agente evangelizacije i naglašava potrebu za prikladnom pastoralnom skrbi koja ih vodi prema punom učeništvu. Papa Ivan Pavao II. isticao je važnost slušanja mladih i njihovog aktivnog uključivanja u život župnih zajednica.
magisterium.assessment_en: The content is fully aligned with Catholic teaching on the importance of pastoral care for youth and evangelization. The emphasis on dialogue and understanding the challenges of youth reflects the Church's practice of encouraging the active participation of youth in the life of the Church.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church recognizes young people as key agents of evangelization and emphasizes the need for appropriate pastoral care which leads them toward full discipleship. Pope Ivan Pavao II. emphasized the importance of listening to young people and their active involvement in the life of parish communities.

sections.subtitle_en: Twentieth Episode of the BP Podcast: Youth, Faith and the Church
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host Marino with guests in the studio, celebrates the jubilee 20th episode of the podcast.
sections.content_en: Host Marino started the jubilee, twentieth episode of the BP podcast, expressing great satisfaction and happiness of the whole team. He pointed out that the theme of tonight's show is extremely important and current: young people, their relationship towards faith and the Church, and the challenges they face. Marino emphasized that this theme was chosen in order to deeply explore the reasons for the distance of young people from faith and how they can be helped in finding the path towards spirituality. In the introductory part, Marino thanked the audience for the support during the previous nineteen episodes, pointing out how time passed quickly and how he looks forward to the continuation. This jubilee episode promises a deep and honest conversation about one of the most important themes in modern society.

sections.subtitle: Predstavljanje Gostiju: Don Tomislav Lukać i Timon Pavlić
sections.screenshot_description: Marino predstavlja Don Tomislava Lukaća i Timona Pavlića, ističući njihove uloge u radu s mladima.
sections.content: Za raspravu o izazovima mladih i vjere, Marino je ugostio dvoje značajnih sugovornika: Don Tomislava Lukaća i Timona Pavlića. Don Tomislav, svećenik salezijanac, trenutno je na službi na Jarunu, gdje djeluje kao upravitelj oratorija i duhovni otac mnogim mladima. Njegovo iskustvo u radu s adolescentima i mladima je bogato i prepoznato. Timon Pavlić je voditelj službe mladih u zajednici Nanovorođeni te u ODS-u, gdje vodi projekt 'Teenage Spirit' koji okuplja mlade. Marino je naglasio kako su obojica gosti koji se prvi put pojavljuju u formatu podcasta, izražavajući zahvalnost što su se odazvali pozivu. Prije nego što su zaronili u glavnu temu, Marino je goste upitao o njihovim vlastitim mladenačkim danima i putu do vjere, želeći otkriti jesu li uvijek bili 'primjeri' vjernika ili su i oni imali svoja lutanja.

magisterium.assessment: Predstavljanje gostiju koji su aktivni u pastoralu mladih (salezijanac i voditelj zajednice) u potpunosti je u skladu s crkvenim poticajima na suradnju svećenstva i laika. Ovakav pristup promiče zajedništvo i apostolat mladih.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkveni dokumenti, poput 'Pastores Dabo Vobis', naglašavaju važnost župnih zajednica i pokreta u formaciji mladih. Suradnja između svećenika i laika ključna je za stvaranje okruženja u kojem mladi mogu prepoznati i odgovoriti na svoj poziv.
magisterium.assessment_en: The presentation of guests who are active in youth ministry (a Salesian and a community leader) is completely in accordance with church encouragements for cooperation between clergy and laity. Such an approach promotes communion and the youth apostolate.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Church documents, such as 'Pastores Dabo Vobis', emphasize the importance of parish communities and movements in the formation of youth. Cooperation between priests and laity is crucial for creating an environment in which youth can recognize and respond to their vocation.

sections.subtitle_en: Introduction of Guests: Don Tomislav Lukać and Timon Pavlić
sections.screenshot_description_en: Marino introduces Don Tomislav Lukać and Timon Pavlić, highlighting their roles in working with youth.
sections.content_en: For the discussion about the challenges of youth and faith, Marino hosted two significant interlocutors: Don Tomislav Lukać and Timon Pavlić. Don Tomislav, a Salesian priest, is currently in service in Jarun, where he acts as the administrator of the oratory and a spiritual father to many young people. His experience in working with adolescents and youth is rich and recognized. Timon Pavlić is the leader of the youth ministry in the Nanovorođeni community and in the ODS, where he leads the 'Teenage Spirit' project which gathers young people. Marino emphasized that both are guests appearing for the first time in a podcast format, expressing gratitude that they responded to the invitation. Before they dove into the main topic, Marino asked the guests about their own youth days and path to faith, wanting to discover if they had always been 'examples' of believers or if they also had their wanderings.

sections.subtitle: Don Tomislav Lukać: Od Tradicionalne Vjere do Svećeničkog Poziva
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomislav Lukać emotivno priča o svom putu vjere i pozivu, s naglaskom na ispovijed i susret sa Salezijancima.
sections.content: Don Tomislav Lukać podijelio je svoje osobno iskustvo odrastanja u katoličkoj obitelji, gdje je vjera bila prisutna, ali često tradicionalna. Ministrirao je u osnovnoj školi, no njegova vjera, kako sam kaže, bila je više 'po inerciji' nego iz dubokog uvjerenja. Priznao je da je bilo i lutanja, posebno tijekom nogometne karijere, gdje se susretao s izazovima koji nisu bili u skladu s katoličkim življenjem. Ključni trenutak dogodio se u trećem razredu srednje škole, kada je kroz duboku ispovijed doživio osobni susret s Bogom. Ta ispovijed, koja ga je 'očistila od svega', poklopila se s providencijalnim susretom sa Salezijancima na Kmanu u Splitu. Don Tomislav je osjetio da Bog ima poseban plan za njega i da ga zove u svećenstvo, s posebnim naglaskom na rad s mladima. Reakcija njegovih roditelja bila je emotivna: majka je plakala, a otac je bio iznenađen, s obzirom na njegovu obećavajuću nogometnu karijeru. Majka mu je kasnije otkrila da su ga, nakon dva spontana pobačaja, ona i otac predali Bogu, smatrajući ga 'malim čudom'. Ovo svjedočanstvo dodatno je potvrdilo Don Tomislavov poziv, pokazujući mu da Bog osobno brine za njega i ima plan za njegov život.

magisterium.assessment: Osobno svjedočanstvo o obraćenju kroz sakramente (ispovijed) i susret s Bogom duboko je ukorijenjeno u katoličkoj duhovnosti. Iskustvo prijelaza iz 'tradicionalne vjere' u osobni odnos s Kristom odražava autentičan put vjere.
magisterium.enrichment: Sakrament pomirenja (ispovijed) je ključan za obraćenje i pomirenje s Bogom i Crkvom. Katekizam Katoličke Crkve naglašava da je ispovijed sakrament obraćenja koji sakramentalno uprisutnjuje Isusov poziv na povratak Ocu.
magisterium.assessment_en: Personal testimony about conversion through the sacraments (confession) and an encounter with God is deeply rooted in Catholic spirituality. The experience of transition from 'traditional faith' into a personal relationship with Christ reflects an authentic path of faith.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The sacrament of reconciliation (confession) is crucial for conversion and reconciliation with God and the Church. The Catechism of the Catholic Church emphasizes that confession is a sacrament of conversion that sacramentally makes present Jesus' call to return to the Father.

sections.subtitle_en: Don Tomislav Lukać: From Traditional Faith to Priestly Vocation
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomislav Lukać emotionally speaks about his path of faith and vocation, with an emphasis on confession and the encounter with the Salezijanci.
sections.content_en: Don Tomislav Lukać shared his personal experience of growing up in a Catholic family, where faith was present, but often traditional. He altar-served in elementary school, but his faith, as he says himself, was more 'by inertia' than out of deep conviction. He admitted that there was also wandering, especially during his football career, where he encountered challenges that were not in accordance with Catholic living. The key moment occurred in the third grade of high school, when through a deep confession he experienced a personal encounter with God. This confession, which 'cleansed him of everything', coincided with a providential encounter with the Salezijanci on Kman in Split. Don Tomislav felt that God had a special plan for him and that He was calling him into the priesthood, with a special emphasis on working with youth. The reaction of his parents was emotional: his mother cried, and his father was surprised, considering his promising football career. His mother later revealed to him that, after two miscarriages, she and his father had surrendered him to God, considering him a 'little miracle'. This testimony additionally confirmed Don Tomislav's calling, showing him that God personally cares for him and has a plan for his life.

sections.subtitle: Timon Pavlić: Od Sumnje do Otkrića Vjere Kroz Zajednicu
sections.screenshot_description: Timon Pavlić opisuje svoje turbulentne tinejdžerske godine i kako je pronašao put do vjere.
sections.content: Timon Pavlić podijelio je svoje iskustvo odrastanja u obitelji gdje se o Bogu rijetko govorilo, a o Crkvi je znao uglavnom preko bake. Njezina smrt, praćena razvodom roditelja, duboko ga je pogodila i dovela do preispitivanja vjere. Osjećao se izdanim od Boga, pitajući se zašto mu uzima ono što voli. Njegove tinejdžerske godine bile su turbulentne, obilježene slobodom, lošim društvom i eksperimentiranjem s opasnim navikama. Priznao je da je često razmišljao kamo bi ga život odveo da nije bilo vjeronauka za krizmanike. Iako je pokušavao izbjeći krizmu, ozbiljnost župnika i potreba za polaganjem ispita doveli su ga u Crkvu. Njegovo prvo ozbiljno iskustvo s Crkvom dogodilo se na 'Hodu za život', gdje je, unatoč početnom otporu, vidio mnogo mladih ljudi koji su aktivni u vjeri. Posebno ga je impresionirao Matija, katehist, koji je s lakoćom odgovarao na njegova teška pitanja o životu i smrti. Timon je shvatio da Crkva nije samo za starije ili 'bolesne', već da u njoj ima mjesta i za mlade, uspješne ljude. Taj susret s autentičnim mladim vjernicima bio je prva iskra koja ga je zapalila za vjeru.

magisterium.assessment: Svjedočanstvo o pronalasku vjere kroz zajednicu i sudjelovanje u crkvenim događajima u skladu je s katoličkim naukom o važnosti zajedništva i svjedočenja vjere. Iskustvo sumnje i ponovnog otkrića vjere čest je put duhovnog rasta.
magisterium.enrichment: Zajednice i pokreti unutar Crkve igraju važnu ulogu u formaciji vjere, pružajući iskustvo kršćanskog prijateljstva i podrške. Crkva potiče mlade da kroz takve oblike zajedništva produbljuju svoj odnos s Bogom i postaju aktivni članovi Crkve.
magisterium.assessment_en: The testimony of finding faith through community and participation in church events is in accordance with Catholic teaching on the importance of communion and witnessing of faith. The experience of doubt and the rediscovery of faith is a common path of spiritual growth.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Communities and movements within the Church play an important role in the formation of faith, providing the experience of Christian friendship and support. The Church encourages young people to deepen their relationship with God through such forms of communion and become active members of the Church.

sections.subtitle_en: Timon Pavlić: From Doubt to the Discovery of Faith Through Community
sections.screenshot_description_en: Timon Pavlić describes his turbulent teenage years and how he found the path to faith.
sections.content_en: Timon Pavlić shared his experience of growing up in a family where God was rarely spoken about, and he knew about the Church mainly through his grandmother. Her death, accompanied by the divorce of his parents, deeply affected him and led to the questioning of his faith. He felt betrayed by God, wondering why He was taking away from him what he loved. His teenage years were turbulent, marked by freedom, bad company, and experimenting with dangerous habits. He admitted that he often thought about where life would have led him if there had been no religious education for confirmation candidates. Although he tried to avoid confirmation, the seriousness of the parish priest and the need to pass the exam brought him to the Church. His first serious experience with the Church happened at 'Hod za život', where, despite initial resistance, he saw many young people who are active in the faith. He was especially impressed by Matija, a catechist, who answered his difficult questions about life and death with ease. Timon realized that the Church is not only for the elderly or the 'sick', but that there is also room in it for young, successful people. That encounter with authentic young believers was the first spark that ignited him for the faith.

sections.subtitle: Don Tomislav Lukać: Salezijanska Karizma i Rad s Mladima kao Životni Poziv
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomislav Lukać objašnjava svoju motivaciju za rad s mladima, povezujući je sa Salezijanskom karizmom.
sections.content: Marino je upitao Don Tomislava zašto se posvetio radu s mladima. Don Tomislav je objasnio da je oduvijek osjećao poziv za rad s djecom i mladima, još od djetinjstva kada je bio voditelj ministranata i pokretač zajednice za mlade u svojoj župi. Njegova želja bila je biti svećenik koji će podučavati mlađe u vjeri. Međutim, u svom okruženju nije pronalazio svećenike koji bi se 'davali' za mlade, što ga je sprječavalo da ranije uđe u sjemenište. Tek susret sa Salezijancima, čija je karizma upravo rad s mladima, potvrdio je njegov poziv. Don Tomislav je istaknuo da su godine adolescencije, od šestog razreda osnovne do drugog razreda srednje škole, ključne 'prekretnice' u životu mladih. Smatra da je u tom razdoblju najljepše i najzanimljivije raditi, jer se tada može najviše utjecati na njihove živote i pomoći im da upoznaju Boga. Njegovo gotovo trogodišnje svećeničko iskustvo, posebno na Jarunu, ispunilo je njegova očekivanja, unatoč ponekad ubitčnom ritmu. Naglasio je važnost Don Boscovih načela, uključujući brigu o zdravlju i odmoru, kako bi svećenici bili snažni i prisutni za mlade.

magisterium.assessment: Salezijanska karizma, utemeljena na svetom Ivanu Boscu, duboko je ukorijenjena u katoličkoj tradiciji i usmjerena na odgoj i spasenje duša mladih. Don Tomislavov poziv odražava autentičnu posvećenost Crkvi i pastoralnoj brizi za mlade, što je u potpunosti u skladu s crkvenim naukom.
magisterium.enrichment: Salezijanska karizma naglašava 'preventivni sustav' koji se temelji na razumu, vjeri i ljubaznosti, stvarajući okruženje u kojem se mladi osjećaju prihvaćeno i vođeno prema svetosti. Sveti Ivan Bosco je naglašavao da je rad s mladima put prema njihovom vječnom spasenju, što je temeljni cilj svakog katoličkog odgoja.
magisterium.assessment_en: The Salesian charism, founded on Saint Ivan Bosco, is deeply rooted in Catholic tradition and directed towards the upbringing and salvation of the souls of the young. Don Tomislav's vocation reflects authentic dedication to the Church and pastoral care for the young, which is completely in accordance with Church teaching.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Salesian charism emphasizes the 'preventive system' which is based on reason, faith, and kindness, creating an environment in which the youth feel accepted and guided towards holiness. Saint Ivan Bosco emphasized that work with the youth is a path towards their eternal salvation, which is the fundamental goal of every Catholic education.

sections.subtitle_en: Don Tomislav Lukać: Salesian Charism and Work with Youth as a Life Vocation
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomislav Lukać explains his motivation for work with youth, connecting it with the Salesian charism.
sections.content_en: Marino asked Don Tomislav why he dedicated himself to working with youth. Don Tomislav explained that he had always felt a calling to work with children and youth, ever since childhood when he was a leader of altar servers and the initiator of a youth community in his parish. His desire was to be a priest who would teach younger people in the faith. However, in his environment he did not find priests who would 'give' themselves for the youth, which prevented him from entering the seminary earlier. Only the encounter with the Salezijanci, whose charism is precisely working with youth, confirmed his calling. Don Tomislav pointed out that the years of adolescence, from the sixth grade of primary school to the second grade of high school, are crucial 'turning points' in the lives of young people. He considers that it is most beautiful and most interesting to work in that period, because then one can influence their lives the most and help them to get to know God. His almost three-year priestly experience, especially in Jarun, fulfilled his expectations, despite the sometimes exhausting rhythm. He emphasized the importance of Don Bosco's principles, including care for health and rest, so that priests would be strong and present for the youth.

sections.subtitle: Timon Pavlić: Svjedočenje Mladih Mladima – Snaga Osobne Priče
sections.screenshot_description: Timon Pavlić govori o važnosti svjedočenja mladih mladima i kako njegova osobna priča pomaže u radu.
sections.content: Timon Pavlić je svoju motivaciju za rad s mladima pronašao u čestim svjedočanstvima obraćenih vjernika koji žale što nisu ranije upoznali Boga. Njegovo vlastito iskustvo obraćenja u srednjoj školi, za razliku od mnogih koji su prošli 'pakao' prije susreta s vjerom, potaknulo ga je da pomogne drugima. Istaknuo je poziv pape Franje da mladi svjedoče mladima, vjerujući da je zbog svoje dobi i sličnih proživljenih borbi bliži adolescentima nego stariji svećenici. Timon je objasnio da se mladima lakše otvoriti nekome tko je prošao slične stvari, nego nekome tko im se čini previše udaljenim ili 'ozbiljnim'. Podijelio je priču o Jimmyju Murphyju i ženi koja je požalila što joj Jimmy nije ranije govorio o Bogu, naglašavajući da mladi ne moraju proživjeti 'pakao života' da bi došli do vjere. Vjeruje da se do mladih može doći puno prije, nudeći im put bez ovisnosti i poroka, kroz autentično svjedočenje i razumijevanje njihovih izazova.

magisterium.assessment: Svjedočenje mladih mladima je ključni element suvremene evangelizacije, što Crkva snažno potiče. Osobna priča, kada je utemeljena na istini Evanđelja, postaje snažno sredstvo za privlačenje drugih Kristu.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkveni dokumenti, poput onih pape Franje, ističu da mladi trebaju biti 'protagonisti evangelizacije' svojih vršnjaka. Važno je da to svjedočenje bude popraćeno solidnom formacijom kako bi osobno iskustvo bilo usklađeno s cjelovitim naukom Crkve.
magisterium.assessment_en: Witnessing of youth to youth is a key element of contemporary evangelization, which the Church strongly encourages. A personal story, when it is founded on the truth of the Gospel, becomes a powerful means for attracting others to Christ.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Church documents, like those of Pope Francis, emphasize that young people should be 'protagonists of evangelization' of their peers. It is important that this witnessing be accompanied by solid formation so that personal experience would be aligned with the integral teaching of the Church.

sections.subtitle_en: Timon Pavlić: Testimony of Youth to Youth – The Power of a Personal Story
sections.screenshot_description_en: Timon Pavlić speaks about the importance of the witnessing of youth to youth and how his personal story helps in the work.
sections.content_en: Timon Pavlić found his motivation for working with youth in the frequent testimonies of converted believers who regret that they did not get to know God earlier. His own experience of conversion in high school, unlike many who went through 'hell' before encountering faith, prompted him to help others. He highlighted the call of Pope Francis for youth to witness to youth, believing that because of his age and similar experienced struggles, he is closer to adolescents than older priests. Timon explained that it is easier for youth to open up to someone who has gone through similar things, than to someone who seems to them too distant or 'serious'. He shared the story of Jimmy Murphy and a woman who regretted that Jimmy had not spoken to her about God earlier, emphasizing that youth do not have to live through the 'hell of life' to come to faith. He believes that youth can be reached much earlier, offering them a path without addictions and vices, through authentic witnessing and understanding of their challenges.

sections.subtitle: Zašto su Mladi Udaljeni od Vjere i Crkve? Kriva Slika kao Glavna Prepreka
sections.screenshot_description: Marino postavlja pitanje o razlozima udaljenosti mladih od vjere i Crkve.
sections.content: Marino je postavio ključno pitanje: zašto su mladi danas, unatoč tome što često vjeruju u Boga, udaljeni od Crkve? Primijetio je da mnogi mladi govore 'Bog da, Crkva ne', što ukazuje na dublji problem. Zanimalo ga je što ih najviše odbija, a što privlači. Don Tomislav i Timon su se složili da je glavni razlog 'kriva slika o Bogu i kriva slika o Crkvi'. Mladi često doživljavaju Boga kao dalekog Stvoritelja, a ne kao osobnog, brižnog Oca. Crkva se, pak, percipira kao institucija puna zabrana, birokracije, skandala i licemjerja, što je često rezultat medijskog utjecaja i nedostatka kritičkog razmišljanja kod mladih. Timon je dodao da i roditelji, prenoseći svoja negativna iskustva, doprinose stvaranju otpora kod djece. Često se Crkva povezuje s 'mafijom', 'pedofilima' i 'križarskim ratovima', što su iskrivljene percepcije. Mladi se boje da će im vjera nešto 'uskratiti', da će im Bog zabraniti uživanje u životu, što je, kako je Timon objasnio, drevna laž koja seže još od Knjige Postanka.

magisterium.assessment: Prepoznavanje 'krive slike o Bogu' kao prepreke vjeri je teološki utemeljeno, jer mnogi mladi danas konstruiraju vlastite predodžbe o Bogu koje ne odgovaraju objavljenoj istini. Ipak, važno je naglasiti da Crkva nije samo 'slika', već sakramentalna stvarnost.
concerns: Potrebno je paziti da se problem ne svede isključivo na 'predrasude' ili 'medije', zanemarujući dublju krizu vjere i potrebu za osobnim susretom s Kristom.
magisterium.enrichment: Kriza vjere često proizlazi iz antropocentričnog pristupa gdje čovjek stavlja sebe u središte, umjesto Boga. Crkva, kao 'sakrament spasenja', poziva na obraćenje srca koje nadilazi puke sociološke ili medijske analize.
magisterium.assessment_en: Recognizing a 'false image of God' as an obstacle to faith is theologically grounded, because many young people today construct their own conceptions of God which do not correspond to the revealed truth. However, it is important to emphasize that the Church is not only an 'image', but a sacramental reality.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The crisis of faith often stems from an anthropocentric approach where man puts himself in the center, instead of God. The Church, as a 'sacrament of salvation', calls for a conversion of heart which transcends mere sociological or media analyses.
concerns_en: Care must be taken not to reduce the problem exclusively to 'prejudices' or 'the media', neglecting the deeper crisis of faith and the need for a personal encounter with Christ.

sections.subtitle_en: Why Are Young People Distant from Faith and the Church? A Wrong Image as the Main Obstacle
sections.screenshot_description_en: Marino poses a question about the reasons for the distance of young people from faith and the Church.
sections.content_en: Marino asked the key question: why are young people today, despite often believing in God, distant from the Church? He noticed that many young people say 'God yes, Church no', which points to a deeper problem. He wanted to know what repels them the most, and what attracts them. Don Tomislav and Timon agreed that the main reason is a 'false image of God and a false image of the Church'. Young people often perceive God as a distant Creator, and not as a personal, caring Father. The Church, on the other hand, is perceived as an institution full of prohibitions, bureaucracy, scandals, and hypocrisy, which is often the result of media influence and a lack of critical thinking among young people. Timon added that parents also, by transmitting their negative experiences, contribute to creating resistance in children. Often the Church is associated with 'mafia', 'pedophiles', and 'crusades', which are distorted perceptions. Young people fear that faith will 'deprive' them of something, that God will forbid them from enjoying life, which is, as Timon explained, an ancient lie that dates back to the Book of Genesis.

sections.subtitle: Odgovornost za Formiranje Slike o Vjeri: Uloga Starijih i Crkve
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomislav Lukać i Timon Pavlić raspravljaju o tome tko je odgovoran za iskrivljenu sliku vjere kod mladih.
sections.content: Marino je postavio pitanje o odgovornosti za formiranje slike o vjeri kod mladih. Don Tomislav Lukać je jasno poručio: 'Mi stariji smo krivi.' Istaknuo je da starije generacije često krive mlade, ali da je problem u tome što nisu dovoljno prisutni u njihovim životima, ne razgovaraju o temama koje ih zanimaju i ne uče ih kritičkom razmišljanju. Svijet se brzo mijenja, a roditelji i Crkva često zaostaju, dopuštajući da mlade odgajaju društvene mreže i influenceri koji ne mare za njihovo dobro, već za profit. Don Tomislav je naglasio da su roditelji primarni odgojitelji, ali da i Crkva, kroz svećenike i časne sestre, mora preuzeti odgovornost. Potrebno je koristiti nove alate i metode, te mladima ponuditi autentične uzore – starije mlade koji radosno žive svoju vjeru. Timon Pavlić je dodao da je mladima najgore kada im se nešto zabrani, a ne objasni zašto. Crkva, kao i roditelji, često kaže 'ne' bez dubljeg objašnjenja, što mlade dovodi do zida i otpora. Istaknuo je da je važno pronaći odgovore i progovoriti jezikom mladih, što je često izazovno, ali nužno za istinsko evangeliziranje.

magisterium.assessment: Priznanje odgovornosti starijih generacija za formaciju mladih u potpunosti je u skladu s crkvenim naukom o ulozi roditelja i zajednice kao primarnih odgojitelja u vjeri. Odgovornost za prijenos vjere je zajednička zadaća cijele Crkve.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva naglašava da je odgoj mladih 'intergeneracijski' proces u kojem stariji, kroz svjedočanstvo života i mudrost, pomažu mladima rasti u vjeri. 'Potrebna je cijela Crkva da bi se odgojilo dijete', kako je isticala službenica Božja sestra Thea Bowman.
magisterium.assessment_en: The recognition of the responsibility of older generations for the formation of youth is fully in accordance with Church teaching on the role of parents and the community as primary educators in the faith. The responsibility for the transmission of the faith is a shared task of the entire Church.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church emphasizes that the upbringing of youth is an 'intergenerational' process in which the older, through the testimony of life and wisdom, help the youth grow in faith. 'The whole Church is needed to raise a child', as the Servant of God Sister Thea Bowman emphasized.

sections.subtitle_en: Responsibility for the Formation of the Image of Faith: The Role of the Elderly and the Church
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomislav Lukać and Timon Pavlić discuss who is responsible for the distorted image of faith among young people.
sections.content_en: Marino asked a question about the responsibility for forming the image of faith among the youth. Don Tomislav Lukać clearly stated: 'We older ones are to blame.' He pointed out that older generations often blame the youth, but that the problem is that they are not sufficiently present in their lives, do not talk about topics that interest them, and do not teach them critical thinking. The world is changing rapidly, and parents and the Church often lag behind, allowing the youth to be raised by social networks and influencers who do not care for their well-being, but for profit. Don Tomislav emphasized that parents are the primary educators, but that the Church as well, through priests and nuns, must take responsibility. It is necessary to use new tools and methods, and to offer the youth authentic role models – older youth who joyfully live their faith. Timon Pavlić added that the worst thing for the youth is when something is forbidden to them, and it is not explained why. The Church, like parents, often says 'no' without a deeper explanation, which leads the youth to a wall and resistance. He pointed out that it is important to find answers and speak the language of the youth, which is often challenging, but necessary for true evangelizing.

sections.subtitle: Suradnja Klerika i Laika: Ključ za Pristup Mladima
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomislav Lukać i Timon Pavlić naglašavaju važnost suradnje između svećenika i laika u radu s mladima.
sections.content: Marino je istaknuo važnost suradnje između 'oficijalne Crkve' i laika u radu s mladima. Don Tomislav Lukać je potvrdio da je ta suradnja prebitna. Iako svećenici donose sakramente, laici su ključni 'svjedoci', kako je rekao Pavao VI. Svjedočanstvo mladih vjernika, koji žive svoju vjeru radosno i autentično, najsnažnije djeluje na adolescente. Don Tomislav je objasnio da laici mogu vjerodostojnije govoriti o temama poput predbračne čistoće ili pornografije, jer mladi vide da oni to žive. Timon Pavlić je potvrdio da snažna suradnja župnika i laika rezultira plodnim vjeronaukom. Njegovo osobno iskustvo pokazuje da su mu mlađi katehisti, koji su živjeli ono što su propovijedali, pomogli razumjeti vjeru. Naglasio je da 'sakramentalizaciji mora prethoditi evangelizacija', odnosno da mladi prvo moraju doživjeti susret s Gospodinom, a tek onda ih se postupno uvodi u sakramente. Obojica su se složila da je ključno mladima predstaviti vjeru na način koji ih privlači, pokazujući im da se u Crkvi može uživati i da vjera donosi radost, a ne samo zabrane. To je posebno važno za adolescente koji se nakon krizme često udaljavaju od Crkve, tražeći svoje mjesto u svijetu.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak ispravno naglašava komplementarnost klerika i laika u poslanju Crkve, što je u skladu s crkvenim naukom o zajedničkom apostolatu.
magisterium.enrichment: Drugi vatikanski sabor i suvremeni dokumenti, poput 'Listen, Teach, Send', ističu važnost 'pastoral de conjunto' (zajedničkog pastoralnog djelovanja) gdje laici, kao svjedoci vjere, surađuju s pastirima u evangelizaciji.
magisterium.assessment_en: The passage correctly emphasizes the complementarity of clerics and laity in the mission of the Church, which is in accordance with the Church's teaching on the common apostolate.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Second Vatican Council and contemporary documents, such as 'Listen, Teach, Send', emphasize the importance of 'pastoral de conjunto' (joint pastoral action) where laypeople, as witnesses of faith, cooperate with pastors in evangelization.

sections.subtitle_en: Cooperation of Clergy and Laity: Key for Approaching Youth
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomislav Lukać and Timon Pavlić emphasize the importance of cooperation between priests and laypeople in work with youth.
sections.content_en: Marino pointed out the importance of cooperation between the 'official Church' and the laity in working with young people. Don Tomislav Lukać confirmed that this cooperation is extremely important. Although priests bring the sacraments, the laity are key 'witnesses', as Pavao VI said. The testimony of young believers, who live their faith joyfully and authentically, has the strongest effect on adolescents. Don Tomislav explained that the laity can speak more credibly about topics like premarital chastity or pornography, because young people see that they live it. Timon Pavlić confirmed that strong cooperation between the parish priest and the laity results in fruitful catechesis. His personal experience shows that younger catechists, who lived what they preached, helped him understand the faith. He emphasized that 'sacramentalization must be preceded by evangelization', that is, that young people must first experience an encounter with the Lord, and only then are they gradually introduced to the sacraments. Both agreed that it is crucial to present the faith to young people in a way that attracts them, showing them that one can enjoy being in the Church and that faith brings joy, and not just prohibitions. This is especially important for adolescents who, after confirmation, often distance themselves from the Church, searching for their place in the world.

sections.subtitle: Povratak Mladih u Crkvu nakon Krizme: Izazovi i Prilike
sections.screenshot_description: Marino postavlja pitanje o privlačenju mladih natrag u Crkvu nakon krizme.
sections.content: Voditelj Marino otvara temu o izazovu privlačenja mladih natrag u Crkvu nakon sakramenta krizme, ističući da mnogi mladi nakon tog sakramenta prestaju aktivno sudjelovati u crkvenom životu. Don Tomislav Lukać, salezijanski svećenik, naglašava da je sakrament ispovijedi često ključan trenutak povratka za mlade. On opisuje ispovijed kao snažno iskustvo Božjeg oproštenja, gdje se mladi osjećaju prihvaćeno i doživljavaju povratak kući. Osim ispovijedi, Don Tomo ističe važnost kampova i oratorija kao mjesta koja privlače mlade, kako one koji su već u Crkvi, tako i one izvan nje. Marino postavlja pitanje dolaze li na te aktivnosti i mladi koji nisu aktivni vjernici, na što Don Tomo potvrđuje, objašnjavajući da su kampovi često privlačni zbog pristupačnih cijena i društvenog aspekta. Naglašava da je cilj spustiti se na razinu mladih i pridobiti ih kroz aktivnosti koje vole, slijedeći pedagoški pristup svetog Ivana Bosca.

magisterium.assessment: Naglasak na sakramentu ispovijedi kao ključnom trenutku povratka vjeri potpuno je usklađen s katoličkom duhovnošću i pastoralnom praksom.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkveni učitelji, uključujući sv. Ivana Pavla II., često su isticali sakrament pomirenja kao susret s Božjim milosrđem koji je nužan za autentičnu obnovu i povratak vjernika u zajedništvo Crkve.
magisterium.assessment_en: The emphasis on the sacrament of confession as a key moment of return to faith is completely aligned with Catholic spirituality and pastoral practice.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Church teachers, including Saint John Paul II, often emphasized the sacrament of reconciliation as an encounter with God's mercy which is necessary for authentic renewal and the return of the faithful to the communion of the Church.

sections.subtitle_en: Return of Youth to the Church after Confirmation: Challenges and Opportunities
sections.screenshot_description_en: Marino poses a question about attracting young people back to the Church after confirmation.
sections.content_en: Host Marino opens the topic about the challenge of attracting young people back to the Church after the sacrament of confirmation, pointing out that many young people after that sacrament stop actively participating in church life. Don Tomislav Lukać, a Salesian priest, emphasizes that the sacrament of confession is often a crucial moment of return for young people. He describes confession as a powerful experience of God's forgiveness, where young people feel accepted and experience a return home. Apart from confession, Don Tomo emphasizes the importance of camps and oratories as places that attract young people, both those who are already in the Church and those outside of it. Marino asks the question whether young people who are not active believers also come to these activities, to which Don Tomo confirms, explaining that camps are often attractive because of affordable prices and the social aspect. He emphasizes that the goal is to descend to the level of young people and win them over through activities they love, following the pedagogical approach of Saint Ivan Bosco.

sections.subtitle: Don Boscov Pristup: Vjera, Razum i Ljubaznost u Odgoju
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomo objašnjava tri stupa Don Boscovog odgojnog sustava.
sections.content: Don Tomislav Lukać objašnjava da ni jedan ekstrem u roditeljskom odgoju nije dobar – ni potpuna permisivnost ni stroga prisila. Umjesto toga, ističe tri stupa odgojnog sustava svetog Ivana Bosca: **vjera, razum i ljubaznost**. To znači da se mlade ne smije samo prisiljavati na vjerske obrede, već im treba objasniti *zašto* je vjera važna, i to na ljubazan i razumljiv način. Don Tomo naglašava važnost postupnosti u odgoju. U ranom djetinjstvu, roditelji trebaju biti čvrsti u postavljanju primjera i navika, poput redovitog odlaska na misu, jer djeca još ne razumiju njezinu važnost. Međutim, u adolescenciji, kada djeca teže samostalnosti i autonomiji, roditelji trebaju koristiti razum i ljubaznost. Trebaju im objasniti vrijednost vjere, koristeći usporedbe i priče, te im vlastitim primjerom pokazati kako se živi vjera. Posebno ističe utjecaj očeva koji mole i žive svoju vjeru. Ključno je provoditi vrijeme s djecom, razgovarati s njima i staviti njihov duhovni razvoj kao prioritet, umjesto da se prepuste brojnim aktivnostima koje nameće suvremeni svijet.

magisterium.assessment: Pristup sv. Ivana Bosca, koji balansira vjeru, razum i ljubaznost, predstavlja temelj katoličke pedagogije i potpuno je u skladu s njegovim karizmom.
magisterium.enrichment: Sustav preventivnog odgoja sv. Ivana Bosca temelji se na ljubavi koja prevenira grijeh, umjesto na pukoj prisili, što odražava Božju očinsku ljubav prema svakom čovjeku.
magisterium.assessment_en: The approach of Saint Ivan Bosco, which balances faith, reason, and kindness, represents the foundation of Catholic pedagogy and is completely in accordance with his charism.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The system of preventive education of Saint John Bosco is based on love that prevents sin, instead of on mere coercion, which reflects God's fatherly love towards every human being.

sections.subtitle_en: Don Bosco's Approach: Faith, Reason and Kindness in Education
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomo explains the three pillars of Don Bosco's educational system.
sections.content_en: Don Tomislav Lukać explains that neither extreme in parental upbringing is good – neither complete permissiveness nor strict coercion. Instead, he highlights the three pillars of the educational system of Saint John Bosco: **faith, reason, and kindness**. This means that the young must not only be forced into religious rites, but they should be explained *why* faith is important, and that in a kind and understandable way. Don Tomo emphasizes the importance of gradualness in upbringing. In early childhood, parents need to be firm in setting examples and habits, like regular attendance at Mass, because children do not yet understand its importance. However, in adolescence, when children strive for independence and autonomy, parents need to use reason and kindness. They need to explain to them the value of faith, using comparisons and stories, and show them by their own example how faith is lived. He especially emphasizes the influence of fathers who pray and live their faith. It is crucial to spend time with children, talk with them, and put their spiritual development as a priority, instead of giving in to the numerous activities imposed by the modern world.

sections.subtitle: Pronalaženje 'Točke Dobrote' u Svakom Mladom Čovjeku
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomo govori o Don Boscovoj 'točki dobrote'.
sections.content: Marino postavlja pitanje o Don Boscovoj 'točki dobrote', na što Don Tomislav Lukać detaljno objašnjava ovaj koncept. Sveti Ivan Bosco radio je s mladima koji su se u doba industrijske revolucije selili u Torino u potrazi za poslom, često završavajući na ulici, neobrazovani i smatrani prijetnjom društvu. Don Bosco nikoga nije otpisivao; vjerovao je da u svakom, pa i najproblematičnijem mladiću, postoji 'točka dobrote' – nešto pozitivno što se može iskoristiti kao poluga za njegov cjeloviti razvoj. Primjerice, ako mladić ne zna raditi ništa drugo, ali dobro pjeva ili svira, Don Bosco bi krenuo od tog talenta. Uključio bi ga u aktivnosti, pohvalio ga, možda mu dao zadatak da osmisli pjesmu za oratorij. Kroz tu početnu vrlinu, postupno bi razvijao i ostale kreposti i talente, odgajajući ga cjelovito. Ovaj pristup naglašava važnost prepoznavanja i poticanja pozitivnih aspekata u svakoj osobi, bez obzira na njezine trenutne nedostatke ili probleme.

magisterium.assessment: Koncept 'točke dobrote' u svakom čovjeku odražava kršćansku antropologiju koja prepoznaje sliku Božju u svakoj osobi, čak i u onima na rubu društva.
magisterium.enrichment: Ovaj pristup sv. Ivana Bosca, koji je tražio dobro u svakom mladiću, izravno proizlazi iz njegove vjere u otkupljenje i dostojanstvo svake osobe, što je ključno za pastoral mladih.
magisterium.assessment_en: The concept of the 'point of goodness' in every human being reflects Christian anthropology which recognizes the image of God in every person, even in those on the margins of society.
magisterium.enrichment_en: This approach of sv. Ivan Bosco, who sought the good in every young man, directly stems from his faith in the redemption and dignity of every person, which is crucial for the youth ministry.

sections.subtitle_en: Finding the 'Point of Goodness' in Every Young Person
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomo speaks about Don Bosco's 'point of goodness'.
sections.content_en: Marino asks a question about Don Bosco's 'point of goodness', to which Don Tomislav Lukać explains this concept in detail. Saint John Bosco worked with young people who, in the era of the Industrial Revolution, moved to Torino in search of work, often ending up on the street, uneducated and considered a threat to society. Don Bosco did not write anyone off; he believed that in everyone, even the most problematic young man, there is a 'point of goodness' – something positive that can be used as a lever for his integral development. For example, if a young man does not know how to do anything else, but sings or plays well, Don Bosco would start from that talent. He would involve him in activities, praise him, perhaps give him the task of creating a song for the oratory. Through this initial virtue, he would gradually develop other virtues and talents, educating him integrally. This approach emphasizes the importance of recognizing and encouraging positive aspects in every person, regardless of their current shortcomings or problems.

sections.subtitle: Zdrave Granice u Druženju s Nevjernicima: Mudrost ili Kompromis?
sections.screenshot_description: Marino pita o postavljanju granica u druženju s prijateljima koji ne dijele vjeru.
sections.content: Marino postavlja pitanje o postavljanju zdravih granica u druženju s prijateljima koji ne dijele vjerska uvjerenja, posebno kada se radi o aktivnostima poput izlazaka, pića ili pušenja. Timon Pavlić nudi jednostavno pravilo: granica je pređena kada prijatelji počnu odvlačiti osobu od Boga, crkvenih aktivnosti ili osobne molitve. On naglašava važnost održavanja kontakta s prijateljima izvan vjerske zajednice, ali ističe da se ne treba družiti svakodnevno ako to ugrožava vlastiti odnos s Bogom. Timonovo iskustvo pokazuje da njegovi prijatelji poštuju njegovu vjeru, a ponekad mu se i otvore tražeći savjet. Don Tomislav Lukać dodaje da je važno zadržati dostojanstvo i autoritet kao vjernik, posebno kao svećenik. Objašnjava da može popiti jedno pivo s odraslim suradnicima, ali nikada ne bi pušio ili sudjelovao u aktivnostima koje bi narušile njegovu ulogu duhovnog oca. Naglašava da je svećenik prvenstveno otac, a tek onda prijatelj, jer samo svećenik može mladima pružiti ono što im prijatelji ne mogu – duhovno vodstvo i sakramente. Spominje i zanimljiv detalj da je salezijancima pušenje zabranjeno po njihovim konstitucijama.

magisterium.assessment: U potpunosti usklađeno s kršćanskim pozivom na svjedočenje u svijetu uz istovremeno očuvanje vlastite duhovne stabilnosti i integriteta vjere.
magisterium.enrichment: Kršćani su pozvani biti 'sol zemlje', što zahtijeva razboritost u odnosima kako bi se izbjeglo kompromitiranje vjere, dok se istovremeno zadržava otvorenost za evangelizaciju bližnjih.
magisterium.assessment_en: Fully aligned with the Christian calling to witness in the world while simultaneously preserving one's own spiritual stability and integrity of faith.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Christians are called to be 'salt of the earth', which requires prudence in relationships in order to avoid compromising the faith, while at the same time maintaining openness to the evangelization of neighbors.

sections.subtitle_en: Healthy Boundaries in Socializing with Unbelievers: Wisdom or Compromise?
sections.screenshot_description_en: Marino asks about setting boundaries in socializing with friends who do not share the faith.
sections.content_en: Marino asks a question about setting healthy boundaries in socializing with friends who do not share religious beliefs, especially when it comes to activities like going out, drinking, or smoking. Timon Pavlić offers a simple rule: the boundary is crossed when friends begin to drag a person away from God, church activities, or personal prayer. He emphasizes the importance of maintaining contact with friends outside the religious community, but points out that one should not socialize daily if that endangers one's own relationship with God. Timon's experience shows that his friends respect his faith, and sometimes they even open up to him seeking advice. Don Tomislav Lukać adds that it is important to maintain dignity and authority as a believer, especially as a priest. He explains that he can drink one beer with adult collaborators, but he would never smoke or participate in activities that would undermine his role as a spiritual father. He emphasizes that a priest is primarily a father, and only then a friend, because only a priest can provide young people with what friends cannot – spiritual guidance and sacraments. He also mentions an interesting detail that smoking is forbidden for Salesians by their constitutions.

sections.subtitle: Don Tomov TikTok: Evangelizacija na Društvenim Mrežama
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomo objašnjava kako je počeo koristiti TikTok za evangelizaciju.
sections.content: Marino pita Don Tomislava Lukaća o njegovoj uspješnoj prisutnosti na TikToku. Don Tomo, koji se opisuje kao introvert i netko tko nije volio kamere, priznaje da je ideja za TikTok došla od njegovih krizmanika i provincijala, a ne od njega samog. Smatra to Božjim djelom, a ne svojim. Iako je u početku imao odbojnost prema TikToku zbog 'zaglupljujućeg sadržaja', shvatio je da je to platforma koju koriste sve generacije i koja nudi sve više kvalitetnog sadržaja, uključujući duhovni. Njegovi prvi viralni videi bili su kratka objašnjenja Velikog tjedna za krizmanike. Iako je bio preplavljen pažnjom medija, osjetio je poziv da nastavi, tumačeći to kao biblijski poziv da ne napusti svoje stado 'vukovima' na društvenim mrežama. Don Tomo ističe da mu TikTok ne oduzima puno vremena jer je već navikao prilagođavati propovijedi djeci i mladima. Smatra TikTok sredstvom za evangelizaciju, a pravi plodovi su mladi koji se vraćaju na misu i ispovijed. Unatoč kritikama 'skrupuloznih vjernika' i ateista, vidi pozitivne rezultate i priliku da dopre do široke publike.

magisterium.assessment: Usklađeno s pozivom na novu evangelizaciju i korištenje suvremenih sredstava komunikacije za širenje Radosne vijesti, slijedeći smjernice o izlasku na 'periferije'.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva prepoznaje digitalni prostor kao 'privilegirano mjesto' za susret s mladima, naglašavajući potrebu za kreativnim pristupom koji ne gubi iz vida srž evanđeoske poruke.
magisterium.assessment_en: Aligned with the call to new evangelization and the use of modern means of communication for spreading the Good News, following the guidelines on going out to the 'peripheries'.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church recognizes the digital space as 'a privileged place' for an encounter with young people, emphasizing the need for a creative approach which does not lose sight of the core of the Gospel message.

sections.subtitle_en: Don Tomo's TikTok: Evangelization on Social Media
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomo explains how he started using TikTok for evangelization.
sections.content_en: Marino asks Don Tomislav Lukać about his successful presence on TikTok. Don Tomo, who describes himself as an introvert and someone who did not like cameras, admits that the idea for TikTok came from his confirmation candidates and provincial, and not from himself. He considers it God's work, not his own. Although he initially had an aversion to TikTok due to 'dumbed-down content', he realized that it is a platform used by all generations and which offers more and more quality content, including spiritual. His first viral videos were short explanations of Holy Week for confirmation candidates. Although he was overwhelmed by media attention, he felt a call to continue, interpreting it as a biblical call not to abandon his flock to the 'wolves' on social networks. Don Tomo points out that TikTok does not take up much of his time because he is already used to adapting sermons for children and youth. He considers TikTok a means for evangelization, and the real fruits are young people who return to Mass and confession. Despite criticism from 'scrupulous believers' and atheists, he sees positive results and an opportunity to reach a wide audience.

sections.subtitle: Rane Veze i 'Prerano Zaljubljivanje': Izazovi za Mlade
sections.screenshot_description: Marino, Don Tomislav i Timon raspravljaju o izazovima ranih veza kod mladih.
sections.content:
Voditelj Marino započinje diskusiju o ranim vezama i fenomenu 'preranog zaljubljivanja', referirajući se na citat blaženog Ivana Merza. Timon Pavlić objašnjava kako rane veze mogu imati dvostruki ishod: neke mlade osobe, koje se upoznaju u srednjoj školi i odluče živjeti svoju vjeru zajedno, uspijevaju izgraditi snažne brakove. Međutim, postoje i primjeri gdje rano zaljubljivanje i želja za partnerom odvode mlade od vjere. Timon naglašava da je ključno prepoznati kada partner počinje odvlačiti osobu od Boga i vjerskih aktivnosti, što bi trebalo biti znak za preispitivanje veze.

Don Tomislav Lukać, iako izuzet od osobnog iskustva u vezama, nudi preporuke temeljene na radu s mladima. Savjetuje mladima da u ranim srednjoškolskim godinama grade čvrsta prijateljstva, a tek pred kraj srednje škole ili na početku fakulteta, ako osjećaju duboku povezanost, uđu u vezu. Ističe da mladi često ulaze u veze iz pogrešnih razloga, poput želje da budu 'faca' jer 'svi drugi imaju' ili zbog fizičke privlačnosti i želje za intimnošću. Don Tomislav upozorava da u takvim slučajevima drugi partner postaje sredstvo za zadovoljenje osobnih potreba, a ne objekt istinske ljubavi.

magisterium.assessment: Usklađeno s katoličkim naukom o važnosti razboritosti u vezama i usmjeravanju prema svetosti, uz ispravno pozivanje na primjer bl. Ivana Merza.
magisterium.enrichment: Bl. Ivan Merz, kao uzor mladima, naglašavao je 'uspjeh pred Bogom' i važnost da se život usmjeri prema svetosti, što uključuje i odgovorno upravljanje afektivnim životom i vezama.
magisterium.assessment_en: Aligned with Catholic teaching on the importance of prudence in relationships and directing towards holiness, with correct reference to the example of bl. Ivan Merz.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Bl. Ivan Merz, as a role model for youth, emphasized 'success before God' and the importance of directing life towards holiness, which also includes responsible management of affective life and relationships.

sections.subtitle_en: Early Relationships and 'Falling in Love Too Early': Challenges for Youth
sections.screenshot_description_en: Marino, Don Tomislav and Timon discuss the challenges of early relationships among young people.
sections.content_en:
The host Marino begins a discussion about early relationships and the phenomenon of 'prematurely falling in love', referring to a quote by Blessed Ivan Merz. Timon Pavlić explains how early relationships can have a double outcome: some young people, who meet in high school and decide to live their faith together, succeed in building strong marriages. However, there are also examples where early falling in love and the desire for a partner lead young people away from the faith. Timon emphasizes that it is crucial to recognize when a partner begins to drag a person away from God and religious activities, which should be a sign to re-examine the relationship.

Don Tomislav Lukać, although exempt from personal experience in relationships, offers recommendations based on his work with young people. He advises young people to build strong friendships in their early high school years, and only towards the end of high school or at the beginning of college, if they feel a deep connection, to enter into a relationship. He points out that young people often enter into relationships for the wrong reasons, such as the desire to be 'cool' because 'everyone else has one' or because of physical attraction and the desire for intimacy. Don Tomislav warns that in such cases, the other partner becomes a means for satisfying personal needs, and not the object of true love.

sections.subtitle: Čistoća i Spolnost: Najveći Izazovi za Mlade Danas
sections.screenshot_description: Timon objašnjava kako mladi doživljavaju Šestu Božju zapovijed i izazove čistoće.
sections.content:
Marino postavlja pitanje o najčešćim problemima s kojima se mladi susreću, posebno ističući čistoću. Timon Pavlić potvrđuje da je čistoća jedan od najvećih izazova. Mnogi mladi, nakon što dožive susret s vjerom, suočavaju se s poteškoćama u prihvaćanju Šeste Božje zapovijedi, a neki čak mole da se ona promijeni. Timon naglašava da je to često prekretnica; mnogi koji odustanu od predbračne čistoće nažalost se udalje i od vjere. Ističe važnost zajednice i prijatelja koji podržavaju život u čistoći, te upozorava na rastuću hiperseksualnost i transrodnu ideologiju koja se nameće mladima u školama, što dodatno otežava borbu za čistoću. Podsjeća da se prva Crkva razlikovala upravo po življenju čistoće.

Don Tomislav se slaže da je spolnost aktualna tema, ali upozorava da se ne smije biti selektivan i fokusirati se isključivo na Šestu zapovijed. Smatra da je površno svesti pripremu zaručnika samo na 'nemojte spavati zajedno', jer brak donosi mnogo dublje probleme. Crkva, prema njemu, mora napredovati u cjelovitom odgoju mladih o spolnosti, učeći ih poštovanju, samodarivanju i značenju tijela kao izraza duše. Ističe da spolni odnos prije potpunog predanja duše postaje 'laž'. Priznaje da su hormonalne promjene i kultura hiperseksualnosti glavni razlozi zašto je ova tema toliko prisutna i privlačna mladima, ali naglašava da je čežnja za sjedinjenjem, koju Bog usađuje, zapravo čežnja za sjedinjenjem s Njim u Kraljevstvu Nebeskom.

magisterium.assessment: Usklađeno s crkvenim naukom o čistoći kao kreposti koja se njeguje u zajednici i koja je ključna za kršćanski život i slobodu.
magisterium.enrichment: Katekizam Katoličke Crkve naglašava da je čistoća krepost koja se razvija u prijateljstvu i vjernosti, te da je svatko pozvan na čedan život prema svom staležu, nalazeći podršku u zajednici vjernika.
magisterium.assessment_en: Aligned with Church teaching on chastity as a virtue which is cultivated in community and which is crucial for Christian life and freedom.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Catechism of the Catholic Church emphasizes that chastity is a virtue that develops in friendship and fidelity, and that everyone is called to a chaste life according to their state, finding support in the community of believers.

sections.subtitle_en: Purity and Sexuality: The Greatest Challenges for Young People Today
sections.screenshot_description_en: Timon explains how young people experience the Sixth Commandment of God and the challenges of purity.
sections.content_en: Marino asks a question about the most common problems that young people face, especially highlighting purity. Timon Pavlić confirms that purity is one of the greatest challenges. Many young people, after they experience an encounter with faith, face difficulties in accepting the Sixth Commandment of God, and some even pray for it to be changed. Timon emphasizes that this is often a turning point; many who give up on premarital purity unfortunately also distance themselves from faith. He highlights the importance of community and friends who support a life in purity, and warns of the growing hypersexuality and transgender ideology that is imposed on young people in schools, which further complicates the struggle for purity. He recalls that the early Church was distinguished precisely by the living of purity. Don Tomislav agrees that sexuality is a current topic, but warns that one must not be selective and focus exclusively on the Sixth Commandment. He considers that it is superficial to reduce the preparation of engaged couples only to 'do not sleep together', because marriage brings much deeper problems. The Church, according to him, must progress in the integral education of young people about sexuality, teaching them respect, self-giving, and the meaning of the body as an expression of the soul. He highlights that sexual intercourse before the complete surrender of the soul becomes a 'lie'. He admits that hormonal changes and the culture of hypersexuality are the main reasons why this topic is so present and attractive to young people, but emphasizes that the longing for union, which God implants, is actually a longing for union with Him in the Kingdom of Heaven.

sections.subtitle: Najteži Aspekti Rada s Mladima: Razmaženost, Manjak Koncentracije i Mentalno Zdravlje
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomislav objašnjava kako razmaženost utječe na mlade i njihov razvoj.
sections.content:
Marino pita goste o najtežim aspektima rada s mladima. Timon Pavlić ističe da je najteže ulagati u odgoj mladih bez trenutnih vidljivih plodova. Često se rezultati vide tek nakon nekoliko godina, a ponekad ih se uopće ne vidi. Također, mladi neprestano preispituju autentičnost odgojitelja, što zahtijeva konstantnu dosljednost i iskrenost.

Don Tomislav Lukać navodi tri ključne poteškoće: 

1.  **Razmaženost:** Mnogi roditelji previše ugađaju djeci, obavljajući sve umjesto njih, što stvara 'invalide' nesposobne za osnovne kućanske poslove i žrtvu. Don Tomislav izražava frustraciju zbog toga, naglašavajući da je teško od takvih mladih stvoriti odgovorne muškarce i žene. 

2.  **Manjak koncentracije:** Društvene mreže poput TikToka skratile su raspon pažnje mladih na minutu ili dvije. To otežava duže propovijedi ili kateheze, iako se Don Tomislav bori protiv te kulture potičući mlade da traže dublji smisao i vjeruju da im Bog može progovoriti i kroz duže izlaganje. 

3.  **Mentalno zdravlje:** Don Tomislav primjećuje alarmantan porast problema poput manjka samopouzdanja, samoozljeđivanja (rezanja), suicidalnih misli i depresije. U takvim slučajevima, on se ne može sam nositi s problemom, već traži pomoć katoličkih psihoterapeuta. Najveća muka nastaje kada roditelji nisu vjernici ili negiraju problem svog djeteta, čime onemogućuju stručnu pomoć. Timon dodaje da su ovi problemi sve prisutniji i, nažalost, normalizirani među mladima, što otežava intervenciju jer roditelji često odbijaju priznati da je njihovo dijete u potrebi.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak ispravno prepoznaje izazove u radu s mladima i naglašava važnost suradnje s psihoterapeutima, što je u skladu s katoličkim naukom o brizi za cjelovito zdravlje osobe.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva prepoznaje važnost mentalnog zdravlja kao dijela cjelovitog ljudskog blagostanja, gdje se duhovna skrb i stručna psihološka pomoć nadopunjuju u služenju osobi. Suradnja s psihoterapeutima odražava odgovornost prema dostojanstvu osobe i njezinoj cjelovitoj dobrobiti.
magisterium.assessment_en: The passage correctly recognizes the challenges in working with youth and emphasizes the importance of cooperation with psychotherapists, which is in accordance with Catholic teaching on the care for the integral health of the person.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church recognizes the importance of mental health as a part of integral human well-being, where spiritual care and professional psychological help complement each other in serving the person. Cooperation with psychotherapists reflects responsibility toward the dignity of the person and their integral well-being.

sections.subtitle_en: The Most Difficult Aspects of Work with Youth: Spoiledness, Lack of Concentration and Mental Health
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomislav explains how spoiledness affects young people and their development.
sections.content_en:
Marino asks the guests about the most difficult aspects of working with youth. Timon Pavlić points out that the most difficult thing is to invest in the upbringing of youth without immediate visible fruits. Often the results are seen only after several years, and sometimes they are not seen at all. Also, youth constantly question the authenticity of the educator, which requires constant consistency and honesty.

Don Tomislav Lukać states three key difficulties: 

1.  **Spoiledness:** Many parents pamper children too much, doing everything instead of them, which creates 'invalids' incapable of basic household chores and sacrifice. Don Tomislav expresses frustration because of this, emphasizing that it is difficult to create responsible men and women from such youth. 

2.  **Lack of concentration:** Social networks like TikTok have shortened the attention span of youth to a minute or two. This makes longer sermons or catecheses difficult, although Don Tomislav fights against this culture by encouraging youth to seek deeper meaning and believe that God can speak to them also through longer presentation. 

3.  **Mental health:** Don Tomislav notices an alarming increase in problems such as lack of self-confidence, self-harm (cutting), suicidal thoughts, and depression. In such cases, he cannot deal with the problem alone, but seeks the help of Catholic psychotherapists. The greatest struggle arises when parents are not believers or deny their child's problem, thereby preventing professional help. Timon adds that these problems are increasingly present and, unfortunately, normalized among youth, which makes intervention difficult because parents often refuse to admit that their child is in need.

sections.subtitle: Svijetli Primjeri i Plodovi Rada s Mladima: Nada i Preobraćenje
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomislav priča o mladima koji su se vratili vjeri nakon dugog razdoblja.
sections.content:
Marino traži od gostiju svijetle primjere i plodove njihovog rada s mladima. Timon Pavlić ističe da mu srce puca kada vidi mlade u ranim godinama zarobljene u ovisnostima ili porocima, ali da je najveća radost kada se netko iz toga izvuče. Prisjeća se dečka iz kvarta koji je bio dio skinhead skupine. Timon je molio za njega i održavao kontakt, što je na kraju dovelo do toga da se mladić odmaknuo od tog načina života, iako nije postao intenzivno aktivan u zajednici. To pokazuje da i sama prisutnost i molitva mogu donijeti plodove.

Don Tomislav naglašava važnost ne odustajanja od mladih. Navodi primjere gdje je pozivanje mladih koji su se udaljili od Crkve, bez osuđivanja, dovelo do njihovog povratka. Mladi cijene što netko nije odustao od njih, što im pomaže shvatiti da ni Bog nije odustao. Spominje i slučajeve mladih koji su se bavili okultnim praksama (poput zazivanja duhova) i pronašli mir kroz molitvu i ispovijed. Kao općenitiji i inspirativniji primjer, Don Tomislav ističe četiri osmaša koji nisu bili odgajani u vjeri niti su pohađali vjeronauk. Kroz prijatelje su došli u oratorij, gdje su osjetili ljepotu vjere i radost zajednice. Vidjevši mlade poput Timona koji svjedoče svoju vjeru, izrazili su želju za krštenjem. Jedan od njih, koji će se krstiti 19. svibnja, čak je počeo predvoditi krunicu u oratoriju. Ovaj primjer pokazuje snagu vršnjačkog svjedočanstva i važnost pružanja prilike mladima da dođu u doticaj s vjerom i zajednicom.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak ispravno naglašava snagu obraćenja i važnost molitve, što je temelj kršćanske nade i pastoralnog rada.
magisterium.enrichment: Svjedočanstva o obraćenju potvrđuju djelovanje milosti u ljudskom životu, pozivajući na strpljivost i ustrajnost u molitvi za druge. Crkva potiče evangelizaciju koja uključuje osobno svjedočanstvo i brigu za one koji su na rubu društva ili vjere.
magisterium.assessment_en: The passage correctly emphasizes the power of conversion and the importance of prayer, which is the foundation of Christian hope and pastoral work.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Testimonies of conversion confirm the action of grace in human life, calling for patience and perseverance in prayer for others. The Church encourages evangelization which includes personal testimony and care for those who are on the margins of society or faith.

sections.subtitle_en: Bright Examples and Fruits of Work with Youth: Hope and Conversion
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomislav talks about young people who returned to the faith after a long period.
sections.content_en:
Marino asks the guests for bright examples and fruits of their work with youth. Timon Pavlić emphasizes that his heart breaks when he sees young people in their early years trapped in addictions or vices, but that the greatest joy is when someone gets out of it. He recalls a guy from the neighborhood who was part of a skinhead group. Timon prayed for him and maintained contact, which in the end led to the young man moving away from that way of life, although he did not become intensely active in the community. This shows that even presence itself and prayer can bring fruits.

Don Tomislav emphasizes the importance of not giving up on young people. He cites examples where inviting young people who had distanced themselves from the Church, without condemnation, led to their return. Young people appreciate that someone did not give up on them, which helps them realize that God has not given up either. He also mentions cases of young people who engaged in occult practices (like summoning spirits) and found peace through prayer and confession. As a more general and inspiring example, Don Tomislav highlights four eighth-graders who were not raised in the faith nor did they attend religious education. Through friends they came to the oratory, where they felt the beauty of the faith and the joy of the community. Seeing young people like Timon who witness their faith, they expressed a desire for baptism. One of them, who will be baptized on May 19, even began to lead the Rosary in the oratory. This example shows the power of peer testimony and the importance of providing an opportunity for young people to come into contact with faith and the community.

sections.subtitle: Završni Savjeti za Mlade i Roditelje: Zajednica i Duhovni Život
sections.screenshot_description: Timon daje savjete mladima o važnosti svjedočanstava i zajednice.
sections.content:
Na kraju podcasta, Marino traži završne savjete za mlade i njihove roditelje. Timon Pavlić preporučuje mladima da traže svjedočanstva, bilo na društvenim mrežama ili YouTubeu, jer ona bude nadu i vjeru, posebno kada vide kako je netko prešao iz teške faze u život s Bogom. Također, potiče ih da se priključe aktivnostima u župi ili blizu nje, jer je važno imati dosljedan sadržaj i program. Kroz zajednicu, mladi mogu pronaći podršku i lakše živjeti svoju vjeru, sudjelujući u sportskim aktivnostima, biblijskim radionicama, druženjima i molitvi.

Don Tomislav se slaže s Timonom o važnosti uključivanja u župne zajednice, jer je lakše živjeti vjeru s drugima u današnjem svijetu. Njegov drugi savjet, posebno za mlade, jest da im mobitel ne bude prva i zadnja stvar u danu. Umjesto toga, preporučuje da se dan započne molitvom i predanjem Bogu, a završi refleksijom o Božjoj prisutnosti tijekom dana. Predlaže 'molitvu u pidžami' – kratko razmišljanje o tome gdje je Bog bio prisutan, gdje je progovorio ili opomenuo, te gdje se moglo bolje. Cilj je 'pokupiti plodove dana', a ne samo 'iskrižati dane u kalendaru', te se predati Bogu s molitvom za bolji sutrašnji dan.

magisterium.assessment: Preporuka za traženje svjedočanstava i uključivanje u župnu zajednicu u potpunosti je usklađena s crkvenim naukom o važnosti zajedništva i duhovnog rasta.
magisterium.enrichment: Zajednica je ključno mjesto za rast u vjeri, gdje se osobni duhovni život hrani sakramentima i međusobnom podrškom. Svjedočanstva drugih mogu biti snažan poticaj za osobno preispitivanje i produbljivanje vlastitog odnosa s Bogom.
magisterium.assessment_en: The recommendation for seeking testimonies and involvement in the parish community is fully aligned with Church teaching on the importance of communion and spiritual growth.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Community is a key place for growth in faith, where personal spiritual life is nourished by sacraments and mutual support. Testimonies of others can be a powerful encouragement for personal self-examination and the deepening of one's own relationship with God.

sections.subtitle_en: Final Advice for Youth and Parents: Community and Spiritual Life
sections.screenshot_description_en: Timon gives advice to young people about the importance of testimonies and community.
sections.content_en:
At the end of the podcast, Marino asks for final advice for young people and their parents. Timon Pavlić recommends to young people to seek testimonies, whether on social networks or YouTube, because they awaken hope and faith, especially when they see how someone transitioned from a difficult phase into life with God. Also, he encourages them to join activities in the parish or near it, because it is important to have consistent content and program. Through the community, young people can find support and more easily live their faith, participating in sports activities, biblical workshops, socializing, and prayer.

Don Tomislav agrees with Timon about the importance of getting involved in parish communities, because it is easier to live faith with others in today's world. His second advice, especially for young people, is that their mobile phone should not be the first and last thing in the day. Instead, he recommends that the day be started with prayer and surrender to God, and ended with reflection on God's presence during the day. He suggests 'prayer in pajamas' – a short reflection on where God was present, where He spoke or warned, and where one could have done better. The goal is to 'gather the fruits of the day', and not just 'cross off days in the calendar', and to surrender to God with a prayer for a better tomorrow.

sections.subtitle: Preporučeni Resursi i Poziv na Aktivnosti Zajednica
sections.screenshot_description: Marino i gosti preporučuju knjige i online resurse za mlade.
sections.content:
Marino traži specifične resurse za mlade. Timon Pavlić preporučuje YouTube kanal 'Nanovo Rođeni' koji nudi brojna svjedočanstva, uključujući i priču 'londonskog gangstera'.

Don Tomislav Lukać, za one koji žele saznati više o salezijanskoj karizmi, preporučuje knjige o Don Boscu: 'Ukrali ste mi srce' (duža biografija) i 'Uspomene iz oratorija'. Za početnike, predlaže i dvodijelni film o Don Boscu.

Na kraju, Marino i gosti pozivaju na aktivnosti svojih zajednica. Timon najavljuje otvorene susrete 'Nanovo Rođenih' petkom u Botincu, te susrete za tinejdžere svaki drugi utorak. Don Tomislav poziva na oratorij u Svetoj Mati Slobode na Jarunu, koji je otvoren svaki dan osim ponedjeljka od 19:45 do 21:30. Utorkom u 21:30 održava se klanjanje u crkvi, a ostalim večerima u isto vrijeme moli se krunica na igralištu. Srednjoškolski vjeronauk održava se svake nedjelje nakon večernje mise u 20:05. Marino zaključuje podcast zahvaljujući gostima i gledateljima, te poziva na praćenje društvenih mreža 'Bože Pobjede' za sve informacije i najavljuje sljedeći podcast u lipnju.

magisterium.assessment: Preporuka duhovne literature i konkretnih župnih aktivnosti potiče mlade na aktivno sudjelovanje u životu Crkve, što je pohvalno i pastoralno ispravno.
magisterium.enrichment: Korištenje kvalitetnih duhovnih resursa i uključivanje u župne oratorije ili zajednice pomaže mladima u formaciji karaktera i produbljivanju vjere. Don Bosco je izvrstan uzor za pastoral mladih, naglašavajući važnost radosti, zajedništva i svetosti u svakodnevici.
magisterium.assessment_en: The recommendation of spiritual literature and concrete parish activities encourages young people to active participation in the life of the Church, which is commendable and pastorally correct.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The use of quality spiritual resources and involvement in parish oratories or communities helps young people in character formation and the deepening of faith. Don Bosco is an excellent role model for youth ministry, emphasizing the importance of joy, community, and holiness in everyday life.

sections.subtitle_en: Recommended Resources and Call to Community Activities
sections.screenshot_description_en: Marino and guests recommend books and online resources for young people.
sections.content_en:
Marino is looking for specific resources for youth. Timon Pavlić recommends the YouTube channel 'Nanovo Rođeni' which offers numerous testimonies, including the story of the 'London gangster'.

Don Tomislav Lukać, for those who want to find out more about the Salesian charism, recommends books about Don Bosco: 'Ukrali ste mi srce' (a longer biography) and 'Uspomene iz oratorija'. For beginners, he also suggests a two-part movie about Don Bosco.

At the end, Marino and the guests invite to the activities of their communities. Timon announces open meetings of 'Nanovo Rođeni' on Fridays in Botinec, and meetings for teenagers every second Tuesday. Don Tomislav invites to the oratory in Sveta Mati Slobode on Jarun, which is open every day except Monday from 19:45 to 21:30. On Tuesdays at 21:30, adoration is held in the church, and on other evenings at the same time, the Rosary is prayed on the playground. High school catechism is held every Sunday after the evening Mass at 20:05. Marino concludes the podcast by thanking the guests and viewers, and invites to follow the social networks of 'Bože Pobjede' for all information and announces the next podcast in June.
